usages.explain: ✦ Indicates the possibility, likelihood. Often used to report news.

examples.content: 大雪のため、新幹線は大幅遅れ模様だ。
examples.transcription: おおゆきのため、しんかんせんはおおはばおくれもようだ。
examples.mean: Due to the heavy snow, the Shinkansen is likely to be significantly delayed.

examples.content: 昨夜十分な証拠がそろわず、彼を逮捕に至らなかった模様だ。
examples.transcription: さくやじゅうぶんなしょうこがそろわず、かれをたいほにいたらなかったもようだ。
examples.mean: It appears that they were unable to arrest him last night as they did not have enough evidence.

examples.content: 大震災後の経済復興が進んでいる模様です。
examples.transcription: だいしんさいごのけいざいふっこうがすすんでいるもようです。
examples.mean: It appears that economic recovery is progressing after the Great Earthquake.

title: ～もようだ（～模様だ）      => look; perhaps; seems
